postconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10^5 for n in test_case_lengths)
postconditions.description: Each test case has a string length between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 100 for t in test_case_count)
postconditions.description: There are between 1 and 100 test cases.
The total length of all strings across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == -1 or (0 <= output[i] <= n for n in test_case_lengths))
postconditions.description: If the output is -1, it means the string cannot be made into a palindrome. Otherwise, the output is the minimum number of characters to erase to make the string a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: all(is_palindrome(s[i]) or (output[i] != -1 and output[i] < n[i]) for i in test_case_count)
postconditions.description: For each string, either it is already a palindrome or by erasing some characters, it can be made into a palindrome with fewer characters erased than the length of the string.
